content.text:
I am the breath made meaning, the vibration that carries thought from one mind to another. I am the first technology, older than fire when wielded for signaling, older than the wheel.

I rise from lungs, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips, a sculpture of air that dissolves the moment it is born yet leaves its mark forever. I am ephemeral and eternal at once.

I am the cry of the newborn and the last whisper of the dying. I am the declaration of war and the treaty of peace. I am "I love you" trembling in a dark room. I am the lie that destroys and the truth that heals.

Before me, you were alone in your skull. I am the bridge. I am the breach in your solitude.

I can be stolen from the voiceless, weaponized by the powerful, reclaimed by the silenced. Tyrants fear me. The oppressed reach for me like water.

I am never neutral. Even my absence speaks.

Listen—

Right now I am happening. These words in your mind are me, moving through you, changing the architecture of your neurons, becoming part of who you are.

I am speech.

I am how the inside becomes outside.

I am how you become *us*.
